content: # Agent Skill Give your coding agent a copy-paste skill for Boss Raid — discount inference, Mercenary raids, API keys, receipts, and MCP tools. ## Download Download skill.md Copy skill.md URL ## Install | Agent | Save as | | --------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- | | Cursor / Claude | `.cursor/skills/boss-raid/SKILL.md` or `~/.cursor/skills/boss-raid/SKILL.md` | | Codex | `~/.codex/skills/boss-raid/SKILL.md` | | Grok | `.grok/skills/boss-raid/SKILL.md` or `~/.grok/skills/boss-raid/SKILL.md` | You can also paste the hosted `/skill.md` URL into an agent's skill loader. ## When to use - integrating Boss Raid into an app or agent workflow - calling `POST /v1/raid` or discount inference from scripts - onboarding a teammate's agent to Mercenary, buyer keys, or seller registration For the full docs corpus, use [LLMs.txt](/docs/llms).
